verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five drawbacks for an individual who talks a lot.

verses.pali: Musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṁ bhaṇati, pharusaṁ bhaṇati, samphappalāpaṁ bhaṇati, kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: They use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, and nonsensical. When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā bahubhāṇismiṁ puggale.
verses.english: These are the five drawbacks for an individual who talks a lot.
There are these five benefits for an individual who talks thoughtfully.

verses.pali: Na musā bhaṇati, na pisuṇaṁ bhaṇati, na pharusaṁ bhaṇati, na samphappalāpaṁ bhaṇati, kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjati.
verses.english: They don’t use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, and nonsensical. When their body breaks up, after death, they’re reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṁsā mantabhāṇismiṁ puggale”ti.
verses.english: These are the five benefits for an individual who talks thoughtfully.”
